subject: Request: One-time pricing exception for Nexum Labs pilot (28% off Hosted API)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: One-time pricing exception for Nexum Labs pilot (28% off Hosted API)

Tessa / Mina —

Quick summary: Nexum Labs (AI-driven supply-chain analytics) is asking for a three-month pilot with an effective 28% discount off our standard Hosted API list price. They expect ~1.2B tokens over the pilot (high-burst inference) and have agreed to a technical SOW and a 6-month post-pilot evaluation clause. Procurement is pushing for a single signed SOW + discounted rate to get started next week.

Why this is strategic:
- Prospect is in the logistics vertical and has strong references (pilot could convert to a multi-region Dedicated deal).
- They’ve committed to a migration evaluation and a potential enterprise contract contingent on pilot success.
- Competitive pressure: two other vendors offering aggressive credits — we need a competitive, but contained, offer.

Request:
- One-time pricing exception: 28% off Hosted API usage for the 3-month pilot (billing monthly).
- Condition the discount on: signed SOW attached, prepayment of month 1, and a pilot success criteria review at day 60.

Attachments: SOW-Pilot-3mo.pdf, pricing-summary.xlsx, Nexum_NDA_redline.docx (redlines from their legal).

Deal details and forecast are in the attached pricing spreadsheet. I recommend approval with the conditions above and a sunset clause: revert to list rates if they don’t move to an enterprise commitment within 90 days of pilot completion.

Happy to jump on a quick call if you want to walk through the numbers.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-01T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: One-time pricing exception for Nexum Labs pilot (28% off Hosted API)

Thanks Karthik — good context. A couple of follow-ups before I can push to Markus for exec sign-off:

1) Can you confirm expected token mix and peak QPS shape? We need to validate capacity and if burst protection/overage guardrails are required.
2) Are there any custom SLAs or data residency asks beyond the standard Hosted offering?
3) Procurement wants to know whether the pilot includes any IP or model fine-tuning (impacts license terms).

If the answers are aligned with what you’ve noted (standard Hosted API, no fine-tuning, prepay month 1), I’m inclined to recommend a conditional approval up to 30% for Strategic trials, but I want Markus to weigh in on the revenue risk / churn guardrails.

Mina
VP, Enterprise Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-01T11:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: One-time pricing exception for Nexum Labs pilot (28% off Hosted API)

Mina — answers inline below and I’ve pasted the key bits from the SOW and pricing sheet.

1) Token mix & QPS: Core inference calls are short (<64 tokens response on average) but very frequent. Expected monthly: 400M prompt tokens / 800M generation tokens (~1.2B total). Peak QPS approx 320 sustained, with short bursts up to ~700 for 10–20 minutes during batch replays.
2) SLAs / residency: No custom residency — will run on AWS us-east-1. They asked for a 99.9% availability objective for the pilot (we should keep our standard SLA language; propose operational commitment, not a contractual SLA change).
3) Fine-tuning / IP: No model fine-tuning or customer-supplied model — standard inference on our hosted models. IP stays with the customer for their data as per standard DPA.

Conditional guardrails I propose if approved:
- Prepayment for month 1 collected before kickoff.
- Auto-throttle to prevent sustained overage beyond agreed burst ceilings; any sustained >20% above forecast moves them to a usage review and potential billing at list.
- Pilot paperwork (SOW + signed DocuSign) in place before we enable production keys.

I’ve attached the pricing-summary.xlsx with a scenario comparing 28% vs 20% discount revenue run rates and the forecast if they convert to Dedicated.

If that looks OK I can provide a one-page executive summary for Markus.

—Karthik
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-02T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: One-time pricing exception for Nexum Labs pilot (28% off Hosted API)

Markus — forwarding Karthik's request with Mina's prelim recommendation. TL;DR: Strategic pilot, strong chance to convert to Dedicated within 6–9 months. Sales is asking for a one-time 28% concession with the guardrails outlined below.

Recommendation: Approve up to 28% for the 3-month pilot provided the following conditions are contractually enforced: prepayment for month 1, strict burst caps, documented success criteria, and an auto-escalation to list rates on sustained overages. We can also include a conversion credit that phases if they sign a 12-month commitment post-pilot.

Karthik / Mina — happy to jump on a 20-minute call if you want to walk through the conversion mechanics.

—Tessa
Senior Director, Commercial Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>

Date: 2028-04-02T12:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: One-time pricing exception for Nexum Labs pilot (28% off Hosted API)

Approve the 28% one-time concession for the 3-month pilot with the conditions recommended by Tessa. A few add-ons from my side:

- Require a minimum monthly committed spend threshold during the pilot (we should collect at least 50% of the expected usage as a deposit to mitigate churn).
- Legal to add a 90-day reversion clause after pilot end: if no conversion or formal extension, we revert to list pricing and reserve the right to invoice unpaid usage at list rates (we'll craft precise language).
- Finance will require visibility into usage daily for the first 30 days; Karthik, please grant finance read-only billing access to the HubSpot + billing dashboard.

Mark this approved and I’ll notify Legal and Finance to prepare the exec memo and the limited concession letter. Karthik — move forward with procurement and get the signed SOW in DocuSign; do not enable production keys until month-1 prepayment clears.

-Markus
Head of Revenue, Redwood Inference

Subject: RE: Nexum pilot — pricing & next steps

Alexandra / Nexum procurement — great to get alignment. Per internal approval today, Redwood can offer a one-time 28% discount on Hosted API usage for the 3-month pilot under the following binding conditions:

1) Prepayment: Month 1 fee collected before activation (invoice attached).
2) Deposit: 50% of forecasted pilot usage collected as deposit and held against billing.
3) Guardrails: Auto-throttling and burst ceilings enforced; sustained usage >20% above forecast triggers usage review and potential billing at list rates.
4) Legal: Signed SOW (attached) and our limited concession letter (to be sent by Legal) returned prior to key activation.
5) Reversion: If no enterprise conversion within 90 days after pilot completion, rates revert to list and finance reserves the right to invoice any unpaid usage at list prices per the concession letter.

Next steps: I’ve attached the SOW and invoice — if you can sign in DocuSign and process the pre-payment by end of day Friday we’ll schedule a kickoff and stand up keys.

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

—Karthik
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
